text:
rachel: Quick sync on CustodianAI onboarding. Partner wants three offerings: hosted tile, downloadable "custodian bundle" for air-gapped customers, and an SI-managed integration (partner operates). Need legal/export clarity and rev-share terms.
sam: Important: downloadable = customers get full weights + runner. Air-gapped customers will want FIPS KMS support and on-prem install docs.
anya: SI-run means partner-managed deployment with our billing proxy. We'll need SLA mapping and who owns incident response. Also clarify metrics/telemetry allowed.
patrick: Rev-share ask from partner: 70/30 partner/redwood for SI-managed, 60/40 for downloadable, and 85/15 for hosted. That's pretty partner-favorable. Legal: any constraints?
legal-bot: We need explicit redistribution clause per marketplace policy. Downloadable SKUs must include redistribution grant type: "no-download", "download-with-attribution", or "download-sublicensable". For rev-share, finance needs a contract appendix and audit rights for usage numbers. Also require export classification for UK/EU/US.
partner-custodian: We can accept "download-with-attribution" and provide FIPS-compatible binaries for the runner. We prefer SI-managed 70/30 split due to operational costs. Partner requests geo-blocking for certain regions (export control).
rachel: Geo-blocking is doable via SKU routing. Ops: can we gate downloads by region and require KMS key provisioning per customer?
ops-bot: Yes. We'll add metadata fields: "download_allowed": "true|false", "kms_requirement": "fips|none", "geo_restrictions": ["list"]. For SI-managed, we'll require a signed health endpoint and RBAC token exchange for the billing proxy.
sam: Need a clear field for license and artifact provenance: manifest SRI, PGP sig, and optional SLSA attestation. Air-gapped installs require both manifest.sig and offline verification instructions.
anya: Telemetry: partner only allows aggregate token counts + error rates. No prompt/response capture. Legal: is aggregated telemetry sufficient for billing/audit?
legal-bot: Aggregated telemetry is acceptable for billing if we include an on-demand audit clause where partner provides detailed logs under NDA for disputed billing. Also, telemetry opt-in must be explicit in partner contract.
patrick: On comms: partner wants a co-branded launch and an embargo of 10 business days. They also want to approve blog copy and quote. Marketing will need logo assets and PR checklist.
partner-custodian: We'll provide logo and quote, yes. We'll sign off on copy with 48h turnaround.
rachel: Contract asks: indemnity cap? partner asks to cap indemnity to insurance limits; counsel wants a higher floor. Legal?
legal-bot: We can accept a capped indemnity if insurer binder meets our minimum (E&O + cyber) and partner provides quick takedown procedure. I'll open PL ticket to review.
sam: Ops checklist I'll need to prepare for staging:
```
- model_name: CustodianAI-13B
- version: 2026-04-01
- artifacts: [weights.tar.gz, runner.tar.gz, manifest.sig, slsa.json]
- download_allowed: true
- kms_requirement: fips
- geo_restrictions: ["CN","RU"]
- telemetry: aggregated_only
- si_managed: true
```
anya: Finance note: for rev-share we need reporting granularity per SKU and partner invoice cadence. Partner wants monthly net-30. We'll add payment terms to appendix.
patrick: Timeline proposal:
- Tue: partner sends insurer binder + SLSA provenance
- Thu: legal to draft redistribution + indemnity appendix
- Next Mon: ops create staging tiles + enable canary
- Two weeks after partner signoff: publish + co-announce (respect embargo)
legal-bot: Filed PL-9111 (indemnity/revshare review) and EX-5012 (export classification). Target responses Fri 17:00 UTC.
partner-custodian: We'll upload insurer binder and SLSA attestation by Wed EOD.
rachel: Action items recap:
- @legal-bot: indemnity + redistribution + export classification by Fri EOD
- @ops-bot: prepare staging metadata schema and canary config
- @sam: draft air-gap install docs and FIPS KMS guidance
- @anya: SLA + billing appendix draft for SI-managed flow
- @partner-custodian: upload insurance + provenance artifacts
If anything blocks, flag here and we can escalate. Thanks all :handshake:
